title: Ohio data centres, AI distillation and Microsoft outages | Sapiver Forge
practical_takeaway: If you manage a service that depends on Microsoft 365, check your fallback communication and recovery arrangements rather than assuming one provider will always be accessible. Windows users concerned about developer-tool telemetry can review optional diagnostic data under Settings → Privacy & security → Diagnostics & feedback. Infrastructure planners should include local consent, power and water impacts in project risk assessments.
